name: ai-trip-planner
description: Open-source, constraint-aware AI trip planner: understands the traveler, searches real providers, optimizes the whole journey.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @trip/shared && npm run build -w @trip/providers && npm run build -w @trip/llm && npm run build -w @trip/engine && npm run build -w @trip/api && npm run build -w @trip/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @trip/api" "npm run dev -w @trip/web"
